test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain language,

A # B means A is the sister of B,

A @ B means A is the son of B,

A & B means A is the wife of B and

A % B means A is the father of B.

E & P @ D% K # L

Based on the above, how is E related to K?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 #
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
%

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Sister
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

Given: E & P @ D% K # L 

E & P → E is the wife of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b89c1fc986a3b7ddbaa3973a523b0f04c154bf348abee430b7c001b3ec4b5a9.png] 

P @ D → P is the son of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/391e60019c4c4f8d09dda98c5c7eca2507e32495bb6acf9bf0a8db3eba3addb3.png] 

D% K → D is the father of K.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0adfeb5d0fc6d17da3ae2ac53897b5db35844dd1d568262858d31c84dde4ac4.png] 

K # L → K is the sister of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3b3fb6e4fed6a44b46393cc740adc2fe9b4267704f3e8cc9402722479c1a108.png] 

Here, E is the sister-in-law or brother's wife of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
